items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who was with Kid Renee when you played with him? [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's the little band. I never did mention all the little short bands. That was one of them. Then we had Henry Russ. Ray McCormick. He was playing that bass or drums? He was playing drums. See, Russ didn't even got all the drums, he was playing trumpet. Trumpet player, drum player, now he's playing bass.
Who was with Kid Renee when you played with him?
I don't know. Al된oy된 stuff. Al된oy된 stuff. Al된oy된 stuff. Al된oy된 stuff. Al된oy된 stuff. Al된oy된 stuff. Al된oy된 stuff. Al된oy된 stuff.
